secret.description: a secret the graph names and never holds: written with its value, kept somewhere else, and read back as the sentinel that stands for it

name.description: what a config or a program asks for it by; the entity id is derived from it, so one name is one secret

value.description: written: the value itself, or an op:// reference to it in 1Password. Stored and read: the sentinel, a salted hash of what was written, safe to show anyone
